cases.answer: interviewAccess exact active token is bearer credential; no listing, create/delete or identity/admin-field edits for public. Missing exact token path read permits invalid-link UI. Active public round/schedule config get is independently public and does not prove token ownership. First access timestamp is one-shot server request.time; response is allowed unique subset of config slots during server survey window, frozen first submittedAt and server update timestamps. Completed response and unsafe private assignment summary are blocked. Client undefined schedule uses legacy round, null waits, string uses schedule and common round. Rules accessScheduleId maps absent/null/nonstring to null legacy, so Rules do not fully encode client's null waiting distinction. Admin rules use raw authenticated email existence/role/bootstrap; client normalizes email, server lookup failure denies. Neither requires email_verified. Four following KST dates are client calculation only.
